caseStudies.title: Manufacturing Systems Case Study
caseStudies.subtitle: Production visibility and repeatable execution
caseStudies.problem: Production teams need clear status, ownership, and next-action visibility without adding unnecessary administrative drag.
constraints: Must be simple enough for daily use
Must avoid becoming another unused dashboard
approach: Identified the decisions that caused delay or ambiguity
Designed lightweight tracking around production flow
Connected visual status to specific actions and owners
impact: Created a scalable foundation for more structured production systems

constraints: Must work with real machine behavior
Should be documented for future users
Needs to support testing without excessive manual overhead
approach: Created representative macro and logging workflows
Documented expected behavior and failure states
Connected testing outputs to actionable engineering decisions
